scoring_justification: DFT calculations are too computationally heavy to re-run in the verifier; the agent's reported values are compared to paper reference with tolerances that absorb typical code-to-code spread.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for formation energy, lattice parameters, exchange energy, and magnetic moment for Ti-Ce co-doped AlN configurations from paper Table 1 and Section 3.1, plus ordering requirements.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'A computational study of magnetic exchange interactions of 3d and 4f electrons in Ti-Ce co-doped AlN', Table 1 and text (Section 3.1).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's reported numbers; for the 64-atom cell E_f and lattice parameters not explicitly reported, a loose physical bound (negative E_f, expanded a/c) is used.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values published in the paper; the reference solution also reproduces them.

outputs.description: Array of three objects, one per co-doped configuration, reporting formation energy, relaxed lattice constants, exchange energy, and total magnetic moment, all computed from the DFT calculations. The hidden checker compares these values to the paper's reference numbers using specified tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The reported values are derived from DFT; tolerances absorb legitimate implementation differences. Structure strings must exactly match the listed names in the description.

steps.description: Evaluate formation energies, lattice constants, exchange energies, magnetic moments, and structural ordering for the three Ti-Ce co-doped configurations against paper reference.
